prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1013; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not use my name on the recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision occurred?
A: It was at an intersection in Katy, Texas. I was going through on a green light, heading straight.
Q: What happened next?
A: A car came from my right side and ran the red light. They hit the passenger side of my car pretty hard.
Q: Were you able to avoid the impact at all?
A: No. I saw them coming at the last second and tried to brake, but there wasn't time.
Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: How fast were you traveling when you entered the intersection?
A: Maybe around the speed limit, I'd guess. I wasn't speeding.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: Side curtain airbags came out. My head hit the window and then my neck snapped back and forward.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care the same day. They diagnosed a neck strain and told me to take it easy.
Q: Are you experiencing any symptoms right now?
A: Yes, my neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head. I also get headaches in the afternoon.
Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?
A: I've missed a couple of days so far. I'm following up with my doctor and doing physical therapy.
Q: Is there anything else you think I should know about the collision?
A: Only that I've got photos of both cars and the intersection, and I can send them to you.
Q: Thank you. We'll follow up with those photos and your medical records. This concludes the statement.
